<style>
:root{--navy:#3b2f4a;--orange:#c98a5b;--cream:#fdf6ec;--ink:#1c2433}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
body{font-family:"Segoe UI",Tahoma,"Noto Naskh Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.8}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:auto;padding:0 20px}
header{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #eadfce;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;color:var(--navy)}
.logo{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff}
nav{display:flex;gap:20px;font-size:15px;color:var(--navy)}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:12px 26px;border-radius:999px}
.btn.alt{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:2px solid var(--navy)}
.hero{padding:64px 0 48px;text-align:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,7vw,60px);color:var(--navy);line-height:1.3}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--orange)}
.hero p{max-width:560px;margin:16px auto 28px;font-size:18px}
.hero .btns{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
section{padding:48px 0}
h2{font-size:28px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:24px;text-align:center}
.grid{display:grid;gap:16px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;border:1px solid #eadfce}
.card .ic{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:var(--orange)}
.card h3{color:var(--navy);margin:6px 0 4px;font-size:19px}
.cats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.cats span{background:#fff;border:1px solid #eadfce;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 20px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:600}
.cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:24px;padding:44px 20px}
.cta h2{color:#fff}
footer{padding:32px 0;text-align:center;color:#6b7280;font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:600px){nav a:not(.btn){display:none}}

.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.chip{font:inherit;border:1px solid #eadfce;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);padding:8px 20px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
.csec{margin:26px 0 12px;color:var(--navy);font-size:20px;border-right:5px solid var(--orange);padding-right:10px}.desc{white-space:pre-line;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#333;margin:10px 0;max-height:190px;overflow:auto;background:#faf6ee;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.chip.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.pgrid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;justify-content:center}.pcard{flex:0 1 220px}
.pcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid #eadfce;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pcard img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;background:#f3ede2}
.pb{padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.pb h3{font-size:16px;color:var(--navy)}
.pr{color:var(--orange);font-weight:800;font-size:19px}
.btn{border:0;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.btn.sm{padding:8px 16px;margin-top:auto}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5}
.cartbtn{font:inherit;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;cursor:pointer}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,40,75,.55);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:20;padding:16px}
.modal.open{display:flex}
.mbox{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;max-width:440px;width:100%;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;padding:20px;position:relative}
.mbox img{width:100%;max-height:260px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;background:#f3ede2}
.mbox h2{color:var(--navy);margin:10px 0 4px;font-size:22px}
.x{position:absolute;top:8px;left:12px;border:0;background:#fff;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer}
.opts{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy)}
select,input,textarea{font:inherit;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d9cdb9;border-radius:10px;width:100%}
.ci{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;padding:10px 0}
.ci img{width:56px;height:56px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}
.ci div{flex:1;display:grid;font-size:14px}.ci small{color:#6b7280}
.x2{border:0;background:none;color:#b42318;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}
.tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:800;margin:14px 0;color:var(--navy)}
.empty{text-align:center;color:#6b7280;padding:16px}
.fgrid{display:grid;gap:10px}
#msg{color:#b42318;font-size:14px;margin-top:8px}
.policy{background:#fff;border:1px solid #eadfce;border-radius:18px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.policy li{margin-right:18px}
.err{color:#b3261e;font-size:14px;min-height:18px}</style>
</head>
